verses.1: And the sons of Aaron were divided into groups: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar, and Itamar.
verses.2: And Nadab and his father died before their ancestors. They had no sons, so Elazar and Itamar became their rulers.
verses.3: And David and Saul divided them among the sons of Eleazar and Achimolech, from the descendants of Itamar, for their service in their work.
verses.4: And the sons of Elazar found many leaders among the descendants of Eitamar. They divided them into two groups: the sons of Elazar were assigned to the house of their fathers, which numbered sixteen. The sons of Eitamar were assigned to their own families.
verses.5: And they divided them into groups, depending on their status. These were the priests and ministers of God, from the descendants of Eleazar and from the descendants of Itamar.
verses.6: And they were written down by Shemaiah, son of Nethanel, the scribe from the tribe of Levi, before the king, the priests, and the leaders of the priests. Also, Ahijam, son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers among the priests and the Levites. They all gathered together in one place, to Elazar and to Jithamar.
verses.7: And the first goer went to Yehoyiriv to learn about the second one.
verses.8: For the third time, to the four rulers.
verses.9: To the fifth king from the beginning of time.
verses.10: To the fifty-third chapter of the eighth book of Abiya.
verses.11: To Jesus the ninth, for his twelve captives.
verses.12: For Eliyashiv, there are twelve units for two years.
verses.13: For the three dozen, it’s fourteen; for the four dozen, it’s sixteen.
verses.14: For Belgium, it’s fifteen and ten; that is, sixteen and ten.
verses.15: To return seventeen and ten, so that its name becomes eleven.
verses.16: In the eleventh year of Jehukiel, there were forty-two years.
verses.17: One and twenty for the two horses.
verses.18: To Lidliah, thirty-three; to Ma’azyah, forty-four.
verses.19: These are their rules for serving God in His house, as they were given by their father Aaron, according to what the LORD, the God of Israel, commanded them.
verses.20: And the sons of Levi, who are freed from the sons of Amram, shall return to the sons of Shuvael. Yekhdyahu.
verses.21: To the children of Rechaviyah, the firstborn of Rechaviyah.
verses.22: To the righteous ones, who are like trees that bear fruit.
verses.23: And my sons, Jeriah, Amariah, the second one, Yahziyel, the third one, and Yekam’am, the fourth one.
verses.24: The sons of Euziel are the sons of Michael. The sons of Michael are Shamiir.
verses.25: Brother Mikha, Yishiyah, to the children of Yishiyah, in memory of him.
verses.26: The sons of Merari were Makhli and Mushi. The sons of Jaaziya were also there.
verses.27: The sons of Merari were Eleazar, Boaz, and Zadok.
verses.28: To Elazar, I will not give him any children.
verses.29: May God have mercy on Kish’s children.
verses.30: And the sons of Musi: Mahli, Eder, and Irion. These are the sons of Levi, from their family.
verses.31: And they also laid down their offerings for their brothers, the sons of Aaron, before David, the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the leaders of the priests. They offered them as offerings for their little brother’s sake.
